verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is a WebRTC SFU/TURN/RealtimeKit platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server for Realtime. The llms.txt file, the OpenAPI spec and the HTTPS APIs are adjacent developer resources, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
